import string
from hypothesis import strategies as st

_SAFE_TEXT_CHARS = st.characters(
    blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"),
    blacklist_characters="<&",
) | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"])

_NAME_START = st.sampled_from(
    string.ascii_letters + "_:" + "0123456789.-"
)
_NAME_CHARS = st.characters(
    blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs", "Zl", "Zp", "Zs"),
    blacklist_characters="<>&\"'=/?! \t\n\r",
)

name_strategy = st.builds(
    lambda s, rest: (s + rest)[:30],
    _NAME_START,
    st.text(alphabet=_NAME_CHARS, max_size=15),
).filter(lambda x: len(x) > 0 and not x.startswith("?") and not x.startswith("/"))

named_entity_strategy = st.sampled_from(
    ["&", "<", ">", """, "'"]
)

numeric_char_ref_strategy = st.one_of(
    st.integers(min_value=32, max_value=0x10FFFF)
    .filter(lambda cp: not (0xD800 <= cp <= 0xDFFF))
    .map(lambda cp: f"&#{cp};"),
    st.integers(min_value=32, max_value=0x10FFFF)
    .filter(lambda cp: not (0xD800 <= cp <= 0xDFFF))
    .map(lambda cp: f"&#x{cp:x};"),
    st.sampled_from(["	", "
", "", "	", "
", ""]),
)

entity_strategy = st.one_of(named_entity_strategy, numeric_char_ref_strategy)

text_chunk_strategy = st.text(alphabet=_SAFE_TEXT_CHARS, min_size=1, max_size=40)

text_content_strategy = st.recursive(
    st.one_of(text_chunk_strategy, entity_strategy),
    lambda children: st.builds(
        lambda a, b: a + b, children, st.one_of(text_chunk_strategy, entity_strategy)
    ),
    max_leaves=4,
)

cdata_strategy = st.text(
    alphabet=st.characters(
        blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"),
        blacklist_characters="",
    ) | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
    max_size=60,
).filter(lambda s: "]]>" not in s).map(
    lambda s: f"<![CDATA[{s}]]>"
)

comment_strategy = st.text(
    alphabet=st.characters(
        blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"),
    ) | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
    max_size=60,
).filter(lambda s: "-->" not in s and not s.endswith("-")).map(
    lambda s: f"<!--{s}-->"
)

pi_strategy = st.builds(
    lambda target, data: f"<?{target} {data}?>",
    name_strategy.filter(lambda n: n.lower() != "xml"),
    st.text(
        alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"))
        | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
        max_size=40,
    ).filter(lambda s: "?>" not in s),
)

dtd_strategy = st.one_of(
    st.builds(
        lambda root, int_sub: f"<!DOCTYPE {root} [{int_sub}]>" if int_sub else f"<!DOCTYPE {root}>",
        name_strategy,
        st.text(
            alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"), blacklist_characters="]>")
            | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
            max_size=40,
        ),
    ),
    st.builds(
        lambda name, val: f'<!ENTITY {name} "{val}">',
        name_strategy,
        st.text(alphabet=_SAFE_TEXT_CHARS, max_size=20),
    ),
    st.builds(
        lambda name, val: f"<!ELEMENT {name} ({val})>",
        name_strategy,
        name_strategy,
    ),
)

unquoted_val_chars = st.characters(
    blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs", "Zl", "Zp", "Zs"),
    blacklist_characters="<>&\"'=/? \t\n\r",
)

attribute_val_strategy = st.one_of(
    st.text(
        alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"), blacklist_characters="<\"")
        | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
        max_size=30,
    ).map(lambda s: f'"{s}"'),
    st.text(
        alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_categories=("Cc", "Cs"), blacklist_characters="<'")
        | st.sampled_from(["\t", "\n", "\r"]),
        max_size=30,
    ).map(lambda s: f"'{s}'"),
    st.text(alphabet=unquoted_val_chars, min_size=1, max_size=20),
)

attribute_strategy = st.builds(
    lambda k, v: f"{k}={v}",
    name_strategy,
    attribute_val_strategy,
)


@st.composite
def attributes_dict_strategy(draw):
    names = draw(st.lists(name_strategy, unique=True, min_size=0, max_size=4))
    attrs = []
    for n in names:
        val = draw(attribute_val_strategy)
        attrs.append(f"{n}={val}")
    return (" " + " ".join(attrs)) if attrs else ""


@st.composite
def element_strategy(draw):
    def make_leaf(tag, attrs):
        return f"<{tag}{attrs}/>"

    def extend_element(inner_strategy):
        @st.composite
        def _nested(draw_nested):
            tag = draw_nested(name_strategy)
            attrs = draw_nested(attributes_dict_strategy())
            is_empty = draw_nested(st.booleans())
            if is_empty:
                return f"<{tag}{attrs}/>"
            children = draw_nested(
                st.lists(
                    st.one_of(
                        inner_strategy,
                        text_content_strategy,
                        cdata_strategy,
                        comment_strategy,
                        pi_strategy,
                    ),
                    min_size=0,
                    max_size=4,
                )
            )
            content = "".join(children)
            return f"<{tag}{attrs}>{content}</{tag}>"

        return _nested()

    base_leaf = st.builds(make_leaf, name_strategy, attributes_dict_strategy())
    return draw(st.recursive(base_leaf, extend_element, max_leaves=15))


prolog_strategy = st.one_of(
    st.just(""),
    st.sampled_from(
        [
            '<?xml version="1.0"?>',
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
            '<?xml version="1.1" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
            '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="no"?>',
        ]
    ),
)

misc_item_strategy = st.one_of(
    comment_strategy,
    pi_strategy,
    dtd_strategy,
    st.sampled_from(["\n", " ", "\t\n", "\r\n"]),
)

misc_strategy = st.lists(misc_item_strategy, min_size=0, max_size=3).map("".join)


@st.composite
def well_formed_document(draw):
    prolog = draw(prolog_strategy)
    m1 = draw(misc_strategy)
    root = draw(element_strategy())
    m2 = draw(misc_strategy)
    parts = [p for p in (prolog, m1, root, m2) if p]
    return "\n".join(parts)


@st.composite
def broken_mismatched_tags(draw):
    tag_a = draw(name_strategy)
    tag_b = draw(name_strategy.filter(lambda x: x != tag_a))
    tag_c = draw(name_strategy.filter(lambda x: x not in (tag_a, tag_b)))
    pattern = draw(st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=2))
    if pattern == 0:
        body = f"<{tag_a}><{tag_b}></{tag_a}></{tag_b}>"
    elif pattern == 1:
        body = f"<{tag_a}><{tag_b}><{tag_c}></{tag_b}></{tag_c}></{tag_a}>"
    else:
        body = f"<{tag_a}><{tag_b}>text</{tag_a}>"
    prolog = draw(prolog_strategy)
    return f"{prolog}\n{body}" if prolog else body


@st.composite
def broken_duplicate_attributes(draw):
    tag = draw(name_strategy)
    attr_name = draw(name_strategy)
    val1 = draw(attribute_val_strategy)
    val2 = draw(attribute_val_strategy)
    other_attr = draw(name_strategy.filter(lambda x: x != attr_name))
    other_val = draw(attribute_val_strategy)
    is_adjacent = draw(st.booleans())
    if is_adjacent:
        attrs = f'{attr_name}={val1} {attr_name}={val2}'
    else:
        attrs = f'{attr_name}={val1} {other_attr}={other_val} {attr_name}={val2}'
    prolog = draw(prolog_strategy)
    elem = f"<{tag} {attrs}/>"
    return f"{prolog}\n{elem}" if prolog else elem


@st.composite
def broken_multiple_roots(draw):
    prolog = draw(prolog_strategy)
    root1 = draw(element_strategy())
    root2 = draw(element_strategy())
    parts = [p for p in (prolog, root1, root2) if p]
    return "\n".join(parts)


broken_strategy = st.one_of(
    broken_mismatched_tags(),
    broken_duplicate_attributes(),
    broken_multiple_roots(),
)

xml_strategy = st.frequency(
    (82, well_formed_document()),
    (18, broken_strategy),
)

import hypothesis.strategies as st

name_strategy = st.text(
    alphabet=st.sampled_from("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_.-:"),
    min_size=1,
    max_size=15
)

@st.composite
def attributes_dict(draw, allow_duplicates=False):
    """Generates lists of attributes with mix of quoted and unquoted values."""
    names = draw(st.lists(name_strategy, min_size=0, max_size=5, unique=not allow_duplicates))
    attrs = []
    for name in names:
        quote_type = draw(st.sampled_from(['double', 'single', 'unquoted']))
        if quote_type == 'double':
            val_chars = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_characters='"<&', min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=20))
            val = f'"{val_chars}"'
        elif quote_type == 'single':
            val_chars = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_characters="'<&", min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=20))
            val = f"'{val_chars}'"
        else:
            val = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.sampled_from("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_.-:"), min_size=1, max_size=15))
        attrs.append((name, val))
    return attrs

@st.composite
def element_strategy(draw, current_depth=0, max_depth=10):
    """Recursively generates well-formed elements within safe nesting bounds."""
    name = draw(name_strategy)
    attrs_list = draw(attributes_dict(allow_duplicates=False))
    attrs_str = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in attrs_list)
    if attrs_str:
        attrs_str = " " + attrs_str

    is_self_closing = draw(st.booleans())
    if is_self_closing or current_depth >= max_depth:
        return f"<{name}{attrs_str}/>"
    
    num_children = draw(st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=4))
    children = []
    for _ in range(num_children):
        child_type = draw(st.sampled_from(['element', 'text', 'cdata', 'comment', 'pi', 'dtd']))
        if child_type == 'element':
            children.append(draw(element_strategy(current_depth + 1, max_depth)))
        elif child_type == 'text':
            text_parts = draw(st.lists(st.one_of(
                st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_characters="<&", min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=1, max_size=20),
                st.sampled_from(['&', '<', '>', '"', ''']),
                st.integers(min_value=32, max_value=0x10FFFF).map(lambda x: f"&#{x};"),
                st.integers(min_value=32, max_value=0x10FFFF).map(lambda x: f"&#x{x:x};")
            ), min_size=1, max_size=3))
            children.append("".join(text_parts))
        elif child_type == 'cdata':
            cdata_content = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=50))
            cdata_content = cdata_content.replace(']]>', ']}')
            children.append(f"<![CDATA[{cdata_content}]]>")
        elif child_type == 'comment':
            comment_content = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_characters="-", min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=50))
            children.append(f"<!--{comment_content}-->")
        elif child_type == 'pi':
            pi_name = draw(name_strategy)
            pi_content = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=50))
            pi_content = pi_content.replace('?>', '? >')
            children.append(f"<?{pi_name} {pi_content}?>")
        elif child_type == 'dtd':
            children.append(draw(st.sampled_from([
                '<!DOCTYPE note SYSTEM "Note.dtd">',
                '<!ENTITY info "Value">',
                '<!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>',
                '<!ATTLIST payment type CDATA "check">'
            ])))
            
    content_str = "".join(children)
    return f"<{name}{attrs_str}>{content_str}</{name}>"

@st.composite
def well_formed_document(draw):
    """Generates complete valid XML documents including optional prologs and misc nodes."""
    has_prolog = draw(st.booleans())
    prolog = ""
    if has_prolog:
        version = draw(st.sampled_from(['1.0', '1.1']))
        encoding = draw(st.sampled_from(['UTF-8', 'utf-8', 'UTF-16', '']))
        encoding_str = f' encoding="{encoding}"' if encoding else ''
        standalone = draw(st.sampled_from(['yes', 'no', '']))
        standalone_str = f' standalone="{standalone}"' if standalone else ''
        prolog = f'<?xml version="{version}"{encoding_str}{standalone_str}?>\n'
        
    misc_before_list = draw(st.lists(st.one_of(
        st.just("<!-- comment before -->"),
        st.just("<?pi before?>"),
        st.just("\n   \t\n")
    ), min_size=0, max_size=3))
    misc_before = "".join(misc_before_list)
    
    root = draw(element_strategy(current_depth=0, max_depth=8))
    
    misc_after_list = draw(st.lists(st.one_of(
        st.just("<!-- comment after -->"),
        st.just("<?pi after?>"),
        st.just("\n   \t\n")
    ), min_size=0, max_size=3))
    misc_after = "".join(misc_after_list)
    
    return f"{prolog}{misc_before}{root}{misc_after}"

@st.composite
def mismatched_tags_strategy(draw):
    """Generates deeply nested mismatched elements to hit tag pairing check logic."""
    depth = draw(st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=5))
    names = [draw(name_strategy) for _ in range(depth)]
    open_tags = "".join(f"<{name}>" for name in names)
    content = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.characters(blacklist_characters="<&", min_codepoint=0x20, max_codepoint=0x10FFFF) | st.sampled_from(['\t', '\n', '\r']), min_size=0, max_size=20))
    close_names = list(names)
    close_names.reverse()
    if close_names == names and len(names) > 1:
        close_names[0], close_names[1] = close_names[1], close_names[0]
    close_tags = "".join(f"</{name}>" for name in close_names)
    return f"{open_tags}{content}{close_tags}"

@st.composite
def duplicate_attributes_strategy(draw):
    """Generates elements containing duplicate attributes to trigger duplicate checks."""
    name = draw(name_strategy)
    other_attrs = draw(attributes_dict(allow_duplicates=False))
    dup_name = draw(name_strategy.filter(lambda x: x not in [k for k, _ in other_attrs]))
    val1 = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.sampled_from("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"), min_size=1, max_size=5))
    val2 = draw(st.text(alphabet=st.sampled_from("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"), min_size=1, max_size=5))
    
    attrs = list(other_attrs)
    attrs.insert(draw(st.integers(0, len(attrs))), (dup_name, f'"{val1}"'))
    attrs.insert(draw(st.integers(0, len(attrs))), (dup_name, f'"{val2}"'))
    
    attrs_str = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in attrs)
    is_self_closing = draw(st.booleans())
    if is_self_closing:
        return f"<{name} {attrs_str}/>"
    else:
        return f"<{name} {attrs_str}>content</{name}>"

@st.composite
def multiple_roots_strategy(draw):
    """Generates documents with multiple root elements to trigger root validation."""
    root1 = draw(element_strategy(current_depth=0, max_depth=3))
    root2 = draw(element_strategy(current_depth=0, max_depth=3))
    maybe_more = draw(st.lists(element_strategy(current_depth=0, max_depth=2), min_size=0, max_size=2))
    all_roots = [root1, root2] + maybe_more
    return "\n".join(all_roots)

@st.composite
def deliberate_break_strategy(draw):
    """Selects one of the targeted mxml validation error conditions."""
    violation_type = draw(st.sampled_from(['mismatch', 'duplicate', 'multi_root']))
    if violation_type == 'mismatch':
        return draw(mismatched_tags_strategy())
    elif violation_type == 'duplicate':
        return draw(duplicate_attributes_strategy())
    else:
        return draw(multiple_roots_strategy())

xml_strategy = st.frequency(
    (82, well_formed_document()),
    (18, deliberate_break_strategy())
)
